title: MS60062: Spectroscopy And Structure Of Glass
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Local structures in oxide glasses, Radial distribution functions and analysis,
Structural units and groups, Distribution of vibrational, rotational and
electronic levels, Infrared and Raman spectra of oxide glasses, Normal
coordinate analysis, Electronic absorption and emission in doped optical
glasses, Group theory and selections rules for vibrational and electronic
transitions, Ligand field and molecular orbital theories, Long lasting phosphor
and applications, Life-time of emitting state, Concentration quenching,
Radiative and nonradiative processes, Charge-transfer bands, Energy-transfer
bands, Controlled electron-phonon interactions in doped optical glasses and
nanocrystallites, Electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR): line shape analysis
for vitreous and devitrified glasses with nanocrystallites, EPR in impurities
and structural defects, Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR): line shape analysis,
Relaxation spectroscopy, Photonics
